entry.title: Mapeamento de Unidade de Rede no macOS
entry.summary:
Este documento descreve o procedimento para mapear uma unidade de rede em computadores Apple (macOS). 1. Abrir o Finder
Abra o Finder no Mac para iniciar o processo. 2. Acessar a opção “Conectar ao servidor”
Na barra superior do Finder, clique em Ir → Conectar ao servidor… Command + K. 3. Inserir o endereço do servidor
No campo “Endereço do Servidor”, digite o endereço da pasta de rede no formato: smb://servidor/pasta
ou afp://servidor/pasta
(Protocolos SMB são os mais usados atualmente.) Clique em Conectar. 4. Selecionar o tipo de conexão
Escolha como deseja se conectar: Usuário Registrado: utilize login e senha autorizados para acesso à rede. Convidado: somente se o servidor permitir acesso de visitantes. ID Apple: requer que ambos os Macs estejam configurados com o mesmo ID Apple (raramente utilizado em redes corporativas). Se solicitado, insira usuário e senha e selecione o volume/pasta que deseja montar.

entry.title: How to Create an Effective Growth Strategy Plan?
entry.summary:
Assessing Current Business Position
Before planning growth, businesses must understand their strengths, weaknesses, and market position. A thorough assessment highlights areas for improvement and growth potential. Clear, measurable goals guide every aspect of the strategy. Goals may include increasing revenue, improving customer retention, or entering new geographic regions. Growth strategies can focus on market penetration, product development, diversification, or market expansion. Evaluating each option ensures the chosen path aligns with business capabilities. A growth strategy plan is a living document. Tracking performance against goals and making adjustments as necessary ensures the strategy remains effective and responsive to change.

Google, which has already shipped many AI tools through its Workspace apps, has made Google Workspace Studio generally available to give more employees access to design, manage and share AI agents, further democratizing agentic workflows. This puts Google directly in competition with Microsoft’s Copilot and undercuts some integrations that brought OpenAI’s ChatGPT into enterprise applications. Workspace Studio is powered by Gemini 3, and while it primarily targets business teams rather than developers, it offers builders a way to offload lower-priority agent tasks.
